text:
jordan: heads up — we found a compatibility gap between the new route_metadata column and the console dashboards. older telemetry rows don't have route_tag, which breaks per-route billing in the console

maya: ugh. is this the envelopev2 migration fallout?

jordan: related but separate. envelopev2 adds normalized attrs, but our new quota routing relies on route_tag/value pairs that weren't present in some backfilled streams. dashboards show 'unknown' and quotas routing picks default tier -> mistakes on cost allocation

sam: could we infer route_tag from route_id for old rows? quick mapping exists for ~70% of tenants, but not all.

lee: mapping would help, but i'm worried about correctness. wrong inference = wrong billing. we need auditability and a safe rollout path.

jordan: proposal: deploy an ingest adaptor shim that enriches incoming legacy-enveloped rows with a computed route_tag + metadata.source_version field. It'd be opt-in per-tenant for the first phase.

maya: opt-in is good. for backfills we need a different story — run a deterministic backfill job that writes route_tag and marks rows with backfill_tag and backfill_job_id.

sam: agree. idea for shim: it emits an audit event to telemetry_stream 'route-enrich' with {tenant, route_id, inferred_route_tag, confidence}. that way console can surface low-confidence rows for ops to review.

lee: sounds reasonable. two caveats: 1) we must keep the schema migration idempotent (DDL safe to re-run), 2) console queries must still be fast — adding joins on route_enrich table might regress dashboards.

jordan: plan for DDL: add nullable route_tag text to analytics.envelopes, default NULL. add backfill_meta jsonb (or string for now) to record backfill_job_id. we will not backfill synchronously; backfill jobs will write directly with INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE to set route_tag when confidence >= 0.9.

maya: can you paste the proposed ALTER?

jordan: ```sql
ALTER TABLE analytics.envelopes ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS route_tag text;
ALTER TABLE analytics.envelopes ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS backfill_meta text;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS envelopes_route_tag_idx ON analytics.envelopes(route_tag) WHERE route_tag IS NOT NULL;
```

sam: index is fine. maybe partial index on (tenant_id, route_tag) would help multi-tenant console queries.

lee: add it: ```sql
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS envelopes_tenant_route_tag_idx ON analytics.envelopes(tenant_id, route_tag) WHERE route_tag IS NOT NULL;
```

maya: UI side: console routes list query currently does GROUP BY route_id. we'll need to fallback to route_tag when available. UX: show a small badge "inferred" for rows where inferred_route_tag != null and confidence < 0.95. ops can click to see audit events.

jordan: I sketched a small adapter service: it subscribes to kafka topic analytics-ingest, enriches envelope, writes to enrich-log (kafka) and to a side-table route_enrich_events for audit. It can also push a delta event to backfill coordinator for scheduled runs.

sam: how about performance? adding a writer per row to another table could be high QPS. we should batch route_enrich_events and make them compacted topic so back pressure is limited.

lee: good call. use compacted kafka topic and a periodic batch upsert into route_enrich_events. also instrument with a meter: ingest.enrich.latency and ingest.enrich.rate.

jordan: ingest-bot: deploy plan?

ingest-bot: deploy scheduled: canary to 5% tenants at 2026-03-25T18:00Z, monitor: ingest.enrich.errors > 1/min or enrich.confidence.mean < 0.8 -> rollback

maya: QA checklist: 
- confirm ALTER runs in CI migration sandbox (no blocking locks)
- run adapter against replay data for 30d window, measure inference coverage and confidence distribution
- create console flag to hide inferred tags until we reach 95% coverage for a tenant

sam: telemetry queries need updates: current quota compute job looks at route_id only. we'll change it to coalesce(route_tag, route_id) as route_identity. need to update materialized views and job SQL.

lee: risk: materialized view refresh times. maybe update the MV to use the new coalesce and test refresh on staging with sample load.

jordan: rollout steps summary: 
1) DDL deploy (nullable fields + indexes)
2) adapter canary + compacted topic + side-table schema
3) update quota job to coalesce(route_tag, route_id) behind a feature flag
4) console UI fallback + inferred badge behind FF
5) backfill job for tenants that opt-in, writes backfill_meta/backfill_job_id
6) Flip FFs after 2 weeks of stable metrics

maya: who owns the backfill run? data-eng or infra?

sam: data-eng owns backfill logic, infra provides compute. we'll schedule via batch infra and ensure job writes are idempotent with job_id tag.

lee: add monitoring: 
- metric: ingest.enrich.coverage_per_tenant (gauge)
- alert: tenant_coverage < 0.7 for >1hr -> paging to data-eng oncall
- dashboard: enrichment confidence histogram + top 20 unmapped route_ids

jordan: logging example from adapter to include in audit: ```json
{"tenant":"acct_123","route_id":"r-45","inferred_route_tag":"pricing-api","confidence":0.87,"ts":2112345678}
```

maya: small nit — prefer snake_case for backfill_meta keys to match existing telemetry.

sam: also we should ensure retention policy for route_enrich_events is 90d and kafka compaction retains latest per (tenant, route_id).

lee: ok. I'll own the DDL and index deploy, canary plan with infra, and the MV refresh tests. jordan take adapter + audit schema. maya do console changes and FF. sam own backfill job and monitoring.

jordan: thanks. i'll open PRs: one for DDL migration, one for adapter service, one for telemetry topics config. linking here when ready. :thumbsup: 

ingest-bot: PR created -> https://git.redwood.ai/p/infra/analytics/envelope-route-enrich/ + CI status pending

maya: thanks — tag me when PRs are ready for review.

sam: moving to action. if any objection in 24h we'll hold.

lee: none from me, proceed. :rocket:
